title: Readiness debt
summary: Recovery, sleep, or general readiness is low enough that consistency and reaction quality are being taxed before the practice block even starts.
telltales: Visual reading feels slower across many task types in the same session
Practice quality swings harder on low-recovery days than the scenario choice alone explains
contraindications: Do not use lifestyle advice to dismiss real mechanical flaws
avoid: Solving every bad consistency day with more volume
